(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターＢ・Ｗ　伝説との遭遇''' ''Pocket Monsters BW: Meetings with the Legends'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} created by [[Momota Inoue]]. It is a one-shot comic based on the games {{game|Black and White|s}}. It was published in the Winter 2010 issue of the '''CoroCoro G''' magazine, which is published twice a year.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
This manga revolves around the adventures of a young boy named [[Touya (MWL)|Touya]], who travels through the [[Unova]] region, battling many [[Pokémon]], meeting various people, including the malevolent [[Team Plasma]] and a mysterious boy named [[N]].
